sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid: linear applicability gates all three checks, operands and result paths target the declared owners, MegaPA units and decimal datatypes are correct, comparisons use the proper violation direction, and buckling evidence is checked on the applicable web and flange hullStructure nodes without optional or accidental-pass logic.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the graph before freezing: gate both formula checks on the linked calculation case having nltl:calculationMethod nltl:linearCalculationMethodValue; currently every targeted ship is checked regardless of applicability. Move nltl:bucklingCriteriaSatisfied from the nltl:structuralMember node to each applicable hullStructure owner (the supplied requiredOwner), covering the web and flange elements without duplicating the fact on the member. Use the canonical unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA rather than qudt:MegaPA, which expands to the wrong namespace. Preserve the declared yieldStrength, web-stress, flange-stress, calculation-case, method, and structural-member paths and readiness/evidence obligations.

Repair before freezing: the bucklingCriteriaSatisfied constraints on web and flange hullStructure nodes are unconditional, so non-linear calculation cases are incorrectly required to satisfy them. Gate both buckling-evidence checks on the linked calculation case having calculationMethod linearCalculationMethodValue, while retaining the current hullStructure ownership and web/flange paths. Preserve the existing canonical MegaPA units, operand paths, and correctly gated direct formula comparisons.

Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid: linear applicability gates all three checks, operands and result paths target the declared owners, MegaPA units and decimal datatypes are correct, comparisons use the proper violation direction, and buckling evidence is checked on the applicable web and flange hullStructure nodes without optional or accidental-pass logic.
